pg_am76z1.title: Our loaves · Crumb & Co
pg_am76z1.description: Country, five-seed rye and a seasonal loaf. Baked at 4am, delivered by 8am across Faridabad and South Delhi.

c.heroP: We bake through the night in Faridabad and deliver before your first coffee. Three loaves, no preservatives, no subscriptions.

c.img:alt: A country sourdough loaf with a crackly scored crust

c.textH: Baked at 4am, on your table by 8
c.textP: Every loaf proves for 36 hours. We start mixing at midnight, bake at four, and our riders leave at six. If it is not at your door by eight, it is free.

c.img:alt: Five-seed rye sliced on a board

c.cardP0: Wheat, rye and a long, slow rise. Crackly crust, open crumb.
c.cardP1: Flax, sunflower, pumpkin, sesame and millet folded through dark rye.

c.textH: Three loaves. That is the whole menu.
c.textP: We would rather bake three breads well than twenty badly. Each one changes a little with the seasons.

c.title: Questions about delivery
c.q1: Which areas do you deliver to?
c.a1: All of Faridabad and South Delhi, every day except Monday.
c.a2: There is no subscription. Order the night before, or not at all.
c.q3: Is it really baked that morning?
c.a3: Yes. We start at midnight and nothing sits overnight.
